added.summary: Tokens `--tag-halo`, `--tag-fill`, `--tag-pad` and `--tag-radius` dress the text built-in components draw over the scene (a nameplate's name and subtitle, a waypoint's label and distance, a status grid's time left): an outline by default, and a ground of their own where a pack sets one, so they read over a bright sky.

fixed.summary: An effect's time left wears the pack's tag tokens; the component's own shadow no longer overrides what a pack sets.
